description.zh:
是否列出内建**SYSTEM_CATALOG**项目，用于提供项目元数据及使用历史数据等信息，详细请参考<props="china">[Information Schema](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tenant-level-information-schema)</props>
<props="intl">[Information Schema](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tenant-level-information-schema)</props>功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to list the built-in **SYSTEM\_CATALOG** project. This project provides information such as project metadata and usage history. For more information, see <props="intl">[Information Schema](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tenant-level-information-schema)</props>.

description.zh: 设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回。
description.en: The token that specifies the starting point of the query. The results are returned in alphabetical order, starting from the entry that immediately follows the marker.

description.zh: 每页返回的最大结果数，默认为10。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 限定返回的资源名称，名称必须以Prefix作为前缀，例如Prefix是a，则返回的资源名均是以a开始的。
description.en: The prefix of the resource names to query. For example, if you specify `a` for this parameter, only resources whose names start with "a" are returned.

description.zh: Quota名称（系统自动生成，可通过登录[MaxCompute控制台](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com)，在左侧导航栏选择**工作区**>**配额**（Quota）**管理**查看获取）。
description.en: The quota name. The system automatically generates this name. To obtain the quota name, log in to the [MaxCompute console](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com) and select **Workspace** > **Quota** **Management** from the navigation pane on the left.

description.zh: Quota昵称（可通过登录[MaxCompute控制台](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com)，在左侧导航栏选择**工作区**>**配额**（Quota）**管理**查看获取）。
description.en: The quota nickname. To obtain the quota nickname, log in to the [MaxCompute console](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com) and select **Workspace** > **Quota** **Management** from the navigation pane on the left.

description.zh: 默认计算Quota的实例ID与付费类型。
description.en: The instance ID and billing method of the default compute quota.

description.zh: 指定排序字段，目前可填的只有 createdTime
description.en: The sort field. The only supported value is `createdTime`.

description.zh: 指定排序顺序，sortBy填写时生效。可填值：ASC,DESC(大小写不敏感)
description.en: The sort order. This parameter takes effect only when `sortBy` is specified. Valid values are `ASC` and `DESC`. The values are case-insensitive.

description.zh: 租户ID。可以通过登录[MaxCompute控制台](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com)，在左侧导航栏选择**租户管理**>**租户属性**查看。
description.en: The tenant ID. To obtain the ID, log in to the [MaxCompute console](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com) and select **Tenant Management** > **Tenant Properties** from the navigation pane on the left.

description.zh:
项目类型。取值：
- **managed**：内部项目。
- **external**：外部项目。
description.en:
The project type. Valid values:

- **managed**: a managed project.

- **external**: an external project.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute list-projects --tenant-id 549500003697 --biz-region cn-beijing --quota-nick-name os_PayAsYouGoQuota --quota-name aliyun_54950003697 --prefix a --marker cHlvZHBzX3VkZl8xMDExNV8xNDU3NDI4NDkzKg== --max-item 10 --sale-tags resourceId_:_b7afb7d1-0000-0000-0000-c393669c307b_,_resourceType_:_PayAsYouGo --type managed --sort-by createdTime --sort-order DESC --list-system-catalog true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/projects --region cn-hangzhou --quotaNickName os_PayAsYouGoQuota --quotaName aliyun_54950003697 --saleTags 'resourceId_:_b7afb7d1-0000-0000-0000-c393669c307b_,_resourceType_:_PayAsYouGo' --prefix a --marker 'cHlvZHBzX3VkZl8xMDExNV8xNDU3NDI4NDkzKg==' --sortOrder DESC --listSystemCatalog true --tenantId 549500003697 --sortBy createdTime --region 'cn-beijing' --maxItem 10 --type managed --header "Content-Type=application/json"
